summary: Backend-only review of the 5 iter225 improvements. Provided suite tests/test_improvements_iter225.js passes 19/19. Regressions still pass: dial_check_iter211 29/29, caller_id_order_usage_iter223 12/12, caller_id_presets_iter219 18/18. I wrote 2 extra test files (voice-service with a mocked Telnyx, bulk-call-service against a throwaway Mongo DB). They found 1 CRITICAL bug: a bulk campaign stops dialing after a carrier 'not in service' lead. They also found 2 medium bugs (a false 'caller ID rejected' notice plus a second dial attempt when a custom caller ID is set; the test-ring throttle can be beaten by concurrent taps) and a few minor gaps. These parts work as described: dialIssue, the bot Quick IVR format check, the trycall invalid_number + trial-record delete, test-ring billing skips (inbound hangup, mid-call timer, bridge transfer, Twilio dial-status), 3d/1d renewal top-up keyboards (phone + hosting), deposit nudges (1h/24h, paid skip, dedupe), renewsoon1 email key, and the expired-resume flowType→submenu mapping.

critical.issue: The branch ends with `return` inside the `for (const lead of pendingLeads)` loop, so fireNextBatch exits. If no other call is in flight (concurrency 1, or the invalid lead is first or last in flight), nothing calls fireNextBatch again: the campaign stays 'running' with pending leads forever. Reproduced in tests/test_iter225_bulk_skip.js: leads [invalid, valid, valid], concurrency 1 → only the invalid number was dialed, and the other 2 stayed 'pending'. Fix: use `continue` instead of `return` (the generic 'failed' branch already falls through).

minor.issue: MEDIUM. With a custom displayCallerId, any non-line-limit error is treated as 'carrier refused caller ID'. A D50 / invalid-destination error therefore triggers _notifyCidRejected (false 'your caller ID was rejected' Telegram message) and a second createOutboundCall. Only then is the invalid-number mapping applied. Reproduced in tests/test_iter225_edge_review.js (2 attempts, 1 false notice). Fix: run the invalid-destination regex before the CID retry branch and return immediately. In bulk campaigns with showAs this doubles the API attempts for every bad lead.

MEDIUM. The check (read testHistory/Mongo) and the write (after createOutboundCall resolves) are not atomic. 5 concurrent taps placed 5 free calls (expected max 3). Fix: reserve the slot before dialing (push the timestamp, or an atomic Mongo $push guarded by an array-size condition) and roll back on error.

LOW. If createOutboundCall throws (instead of returning {error}), pendingTargets[target] stays set for ~2 min and the exception reaches the bot handler (_index.js ~31295 has no try/catch). The real telnyx-service catches its errors, so this is low risk. Wrap it in try/catch and delete pendingTargets on failure.

Only synchronous dial-API rejects are mapped. Telnyx D50 is a SIP 404 and usually arrives later as call.hangup (hangup_cause unallocated_number / sip 404/604). Those leads end as 'failed' (not billed) but are not counted under 'Not in service (skipped)' in the final report. Consider mapping unallocated_number / sip_hangup_cause 404/604 to the same skipped status.
No invalidNumber mapping for Twilio errors (e.g. 21211 / 13224 invalid To). Legacy Twilio numbers get the generic failure.

Plan-upgrade deposits (orders.js:219, forNumber = existing active number + forUpgrade) look up webNumberOrders by phoneNumber. The latest order is 'completed', so these abandoned deposits are never nudged (safe, but missed). Also, every abandoned deposit is nudged separately: 3 abandoned attempts → 6 emails. Consider nudging only the latest open deposit per user. The comment says 'stops once cancelled', but webDeposits has no status check.

The 1-day email reuses the 3-day renewSoon copy (same subject, nothing about it being tomorrow). It is also sent in the 'ok' variant (auto-renew on and funded), which is noise. Consider sending the 1-day email only for short/manual, or using 'tomorrow' copy.

flowType 'leads-purchase' and 'vcard-order' (from _resumeFlowType) are not mapped, so they fall back to the old 'start again from the menu' message. The fa translation is missing in that fallback string.

Info only. Hard-rejects NANP numbers that libphonenumber 1.13.15 (latest) marks invalid, e.g. +1861…, +1624…, +1471… today. A brand-new area code goes live before the metadata update, so real numbers get blocked until the dependency is bumped. Consider a soft warning, or relying on the carrier skip for isValid()===false.

action_items: CRITICAL: bulk-call-service.js fireNextBatch invalidNumber branch: change `return` to `continue` so the campaign keeps dialing after a not-in-service lead (re-run tests/test_iter225_bulk_skip.js, which should PASS)
voice-service.js initiateOutboundIvrCall: detect invalid destination (D50/LRN/unallocated) before the custom caller-ID retry. No _notifyCidRejected and no second dial for bad destinations
test-my-number.js: make the 3-per-24h throttle atomic (reserve the slot before dialing), and wrap createOutboundCall in try/catch that clears pendingTargets
Optional: map async hangup causes (unallocated_number, sip 404/604) to 'not in service, skipped' in the bulk report; add invalidNumber mapping on the Twilio path
Optional: deposit nudges for plan-upgrade deposits and one nudge set per user; 1-day renewal email copy; map leads-purchase/vcard-order in expired resume
critical_code_review_comments: fireNextBatch: early `return` inside the per-lead loop silently ends the batch. Only the 'paused for wallet' and 'provider suspended' cases should return.
Invalid-destination mapping depends on regex-matching Telnyx error detail text. Also check result.code (createOutboundCall already returns code).
isFreeTestRing is keyed only on TRIAL_CALLER_ID → target within a 2 min window. Acceptable, but any other call from the trial line to that number in that window is also free.
_index.js is ~51k lines. The new handlers add to it rather than living in modules.

success_rate.backend: Provided suite 19/19 (100%). Extra review checks 6/11 pass (1 critical, 2 medium, 1 low failure)

seed_data_creation: None in real DB. Throwaway Mongo DBs test_iter225_* (created by the test scripts) were dropped after each run. No real calls, payments or emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/js && node tests/test_improvements_iter225.js (19/19), node tests/test_iter225_edge_review.js (5 FAILs expected until the CID-retry, throttle-race and throw-handling fixes land), node tests/test_iter225_bulk_skip.js (FAIL until the fireNextBatch return→continue fix). The edge test mocks Telnyx via voiceService.initVoiceService({telnyxApi}). The bulk test monkeypatches voice-service.initiateOutboundIvrCall and uses a throwaway DB.
rca of the issue: Bulk stall: in bulk-call-service.js ~1162 the new invalidNumber handling copies the pause-style `return` from the wallet/provider branches. Those are meant to stop the batch; a skipped lead is not. fireNextBatch is only re-triggered by a call completing (line 1394) or by retryLater. With nothing in flight, nothing re-triggers it. Repro: tests/test_iter225_bulk_skip.js. Mitigation: `continue`.
